name: Tower! Simulator 3: PANC Airport
summary:
Step into one of the world’s most unique and challenging aviation hubs with PANC – Anchorage, the latest expansion for Tower! Simulator 3—and the first airport in the series to feature snow environments.

Anchorage isn’t just another airport—it's a global cargo powerhouse and a critical stopover between Asia and North America. With a mix of heavy freighters, passenger traffic, and unpredictable Alaskan weather, every shift becomes a test of timing, precision, and situational awareness.
